sam: Quick heads-up — PSU rotation + thermal watch for rack r-42 in us-east1. Planned window Tue 2026-04-12 02:00-05:00 UTC. We'll do rolling PSU swaps across chassis, expect brief node reboots (1-2m) during handover. Aim: avoid extended downtime. Impact: ~6 GPUs out of 96 out of service at peak per minute, best-effort backfill. Any objections?

maya: Sounds fine. Can we shift 30m later to avoid the early-morning deploy window? :eyes: 

opsbot: Scheduled maintenance created: MNT-8721. Notifying oncall and creating incident placeholder. Link: https://redwood.internal/maint/MNT-8721 

liam: How much burst capacity do we have? need to ensure dedicated pools don't starve. 

sam: We can burst to spare-pool for ~20 min without impacting SLAs. Expected tail latency increase ~5-8% for small fraction of requests. Numbers: spare GPUs 12, target headroom 8. Canary plan: cordon 1 chassis, reboot, validate perf for 10min, then proceed.

pablo: We'll prep support notice. Draft: "Planned maintenance in us-east1 may cause transient request latency and short reconnects. No data loss expected." Want to link an FAQ? 

sam: Yes please. Add fallback info for customers pinned to older model variants and mention auto-fallback will route to eu-west if capacity exceeded. 

infra-oncall: Need the runbook snippets and exact cordon/drain commands to follow. Also request we tag maintenance in /alerts so monitoring suppresses noisy alarms. 

sam: Runbook snippet: 
```
# cordon
kubectl cordon node-r42-ch3
# drain with grace
kubectl drain node-r42-ch3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# after swap
ssh ops@bmc-r42-ch3 'psu replace 2 && thermal-sensor reset'
kubectl uncordon node-r42-ch3
```

maya: Will update schedule to 02:30-05:30 UTC and inform infra-oncall. 

liam: I'll reserve burst capacity and set a temporary upper-bound on batch jobs during the window. 

pablo: Support notice queued for 02:00 UTC, we'll hold off sending until 02:15 if schedule changes. 

sam: Great — I'll post final confirmation 02:00 UTC and update the maint ticket with timestamps and thermal logs. :thumbsup: 

opsbot: Incident placeholder MNT-8721 updated by sam at 4999990300.
